content: The river that flows in you also flows in me. Why do we wander to distant shrines when the Beloved dwells within the temple of the heart?
author: Kabir
explanation:
Sant Kabir shattered the rigid walls of sectarian dogmatism with effortless mystical clarity. We exhaust our lives walking to distant pilgrimage sites, reciting external mantras, and arguing over theological doctrines, completely blind to the living presence of the Divine breathing within our own chest. The sacred current that sustains every living soul is identical in all beings.

When you recognize the Beloved inside your own heart, every fellow human being becomes a living sanctuary of the Divine.
practicalInsight: Treat the next person you encounter today—regardless of their social standing or background—as a living temple of the sacred spirit.
reflectionPrompt: What external validations or rituals are you chasing when the peace you seek is already waiting in your own quiet heart?
